gloss: year-on-year; compared with the previous year

definitions.gloss: year-on-year comparison; compared with the previous year
definitions.explanation: A comparison of a figure with the same figure a year earlier, as used in business and economic reports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前年比|ぜんねんひ}{一割|いちわり}{増|ぞう}だった。
examples.english: Sales were up 10 percent year on year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{前年比|ぜんねんひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧になった。
examples.english: The number of tourists doubled compared with the previous year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{輸出額|ゆしゅつがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前年比|ぜんねんひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧し、⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧か{月|げつ}⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マイナス→マイナス：00268_mainasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This month's exports fell 3 percent year on year, the second straight month of decline.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {前年比|ぜんねんひ}〜{増|ぞう}/{減|げん}: up/down ~ year on year (headline style)
- {前年比|ぜんねんひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: compared with the previous year

RELATED WORDS:
- {前月比|ぜんげつひ}: month-on-month
- ⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧{同月比|どうげつひ}: compared with the same month last year
- ⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧: the previous year
